issue.title: Alert on hostile CPU, /tmp execution, and mining-pool egress on athena

task_type_fields.proposal: Prometheus alerts for service-account CPU, exec from writable dirs, and mining-pool egress on athena
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Incident response for the athena Plex compromise contains and patches the host; monitoring changes are separate infrastructure work the approved plan defers to follow-ups.

issue.creation_reason: The athena Plex compromise ran a miner at load ~70 for about five hours before anyone noticed; existing node_exporter metrics had no alert for it.

payload.description: Restrict monitoring listeners without disrupting future detection rules or the existing email route

payload.entry: INTEGRATION from bob-cli-8v landing, proposed by bob-cli-8v.1 note #5: athena.apt rules and email delivery are now live. Reuse the existing Alertmanager 127.0.0.1:9093 -> localhost Postfix/Mailjet -> bryanbugyi34@gmail.com route, send_resolved=true, grouping by alertname, 24h repeats; do not install a second delivery stack. Phase evidence verified FIRING pipeline/stale/disk alerts and RESOLVED stale in Gmail on 2026-10-17. Landing on 2026-10-18 independently checked all seven athena.apt rules health=ok and Alertmanager email notifications_total=5 with all email failed counters=0. Tailnet 1657987 plus 60d34ae/95c8a50 contains source/runbook. Listener exposure is a separate follow-up bob-cli-97.
